name.value: Bowen Island Historians Museum and Archive

description.value: The Bowen Island Museum & Archives is a community-run institution founded in 1967 that preserves the island's social and natural history through photographs, letters, maps, oral histories, and artifacts. Highlights include the permanent Higgins Cabin exhibit — a two-room recreation of a 1948 logger's life — and a rotating gallery in the Catherine Carter Room. For cycling visitors arriving by BC Ferries, the museum sits a short ride from the Snug Cove ferry terminal and offers admission by donation.
